datalab-to/ocr.pricingNotes: Official page-billed model at $2 per 1,000 input pages. AutoShow uses the fixed per-page rate; taxes, credits, and discounts are excluded.

limits.notes: The Replicate model schema accepts PDF, DOC, DOCX, PPT, PPTX, PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WEBP inputs. AutoShow currently routes PDF and image OCR inputs.

datalab-to/marker.description: Datalab Marker (Replicate official model; fast mode)
datalab-to/marker.pricingNotes: AutoShow pins Marker to mode=fast, billed at $4 per 1,000 input pages. Replicate bills balanced and accurate modes, or requests with page_schema, at $6 per 1,000 pages; those modes are not exposed until their distinct execution and price selections can be represented.

limits.notes: The Replicate model schema accepts PDF, DOC, DOCX, PPT, PPTX, PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WEBP inputs. AutoShow currently routes PDF and image OCR inputs. The supported selector always sends mode=fast.

lucataco/deepseek-ocr.description: DeepSeek OCR (Replicate community deployment; pinned version)
lucataco/deepseek-ocr.pricingNotes: The verified community deployment is pinned to version cb3b474fbfc56b1664c8c7841550bccecbe7b74c30e45ce938ffca1180b4dff5 at dispatch. Replicate estimates about $0.0033 per approximately four-second prediction on L40S hardware. AutoShow estimates one prediction per rendered page ($3.30 per 1,000 pages); actual billing is duration-based and can vary with input complexity, cold starts, taxes, credits, and discounts.

limits.notes: The pinned schema accepts one image input per prediction. AutoShow renders PDF pages to PNG and submits each page with task_type=Convert to Markdown and resolution_size=Gundam (Recommended).
